title: Fan Token Zone
tagline: Fan Token Zone is a social wallet holding your Chiliz fan tokens allowing anyone to make predictions of their team against their rivals.
description:
This project uses web3auth to handle social logins and the Chiliz fan tokens.

Based on fan tokens in your wallet, only certain pages will be displayed. Each is a Fan Token page of content relevant for that team.

In the fan token page, users can make a prediction about their team. This is attested on the Sepolia network using Sign protocol.

A feature of this project was supposed to use Galadriel AI to create updated content on the team of the fan tokens and also make attestations and predictions, and resolve them.
how_its_made: This projects uses web3auth to allow users to log in via social logins. On the chiliz mainnet and spicy testnet, the app scans a user's wallet for fan tokens. Based on fan tokens in your wallet, only certain pages will be displayed. Each is a Fan Token page of content relevant for that team. In the fan token page, users can make a prediction about their team. This is attested on the Sepolia network using Sign protocol.
